name: LiPo charger module (TP4056 with protection, USB-C)
description: Charges a 1S LiPo from its own USB-C socket (constant current, then 4.2 V constant voltage) and protects it. BAT (B+) and GND.2 (B−) to the cell; OUT (OUT+) and GND.3 (OUT−) feed the device: a Pico's VSYS directly, a XIAO / RP2040-Zero 5V pin through a slide switch and a Schottky diode (stripe towards the board). IN+ / IN− are the USB input: leave them unconnected (the module's USB-C socket is the charge port; plug it with press or prop usb), never wire them to the board's 5V. Red LED = charging, blue = full. The charge current is 1 A as sold: for a small cell lower it to 1C (chargeCurrentmA, R_PROG).

pins.label: IN+
pins.description: USB 5 V input, the same node as the module's USB-C socket (4.5 to 5.5 V, 8 V absolute max). Usually left unconnected: the person plugs a USB charger into the socket. Do not wire it to the board's 5V / VBUS: that would only charge while the board itself is on USB, and back-feeds the board from the charger.

pins.label: IN−
pins.description: USB input ground (same as the socket's ground). Usually left unconnected.

pins.label: B+
pins.description: To the LiPo cell's + (red). The cell's connection, not a supply output: power the device from OUT.

pins.label: OUT+
pins.description: Protected battery output (3.0 to 4.2 V, the cell behind the protection FETs) to the device: Pico VSYS directly; XIAO / RP2040-Zero 5V through a slide switch and a Schottky diode (so USB on the board cannot back-feed the cell). Not 5 V: add a boost converter (boost-converter) for 5 V boards.

props.label: USB cable plugged in
props.description: A USB charger gives the module 5 V. press toggles it.

props.label: Charge current (R_PROG)
props.description: Set by R_PROG: 1.2 kΩ = 1000 mA (as sold), 2 kΩ = 580, 3 kΩ = 400, 5 kΩ = 250, 10 kΩ = 130. Keep it at or below the cell's capacity (1C).

footprint: 28 × 17.5 mm module, USB-C socket, solder pads IN+ IN− B+ B− OUT+ OUT−

bindings.description: The protection has cut OUT off (cell below 2.4 V).
